rca of the issue: Original bug in iter-116: admin_get_kiosk_qr_provider used {**DEFAULT_QR_CFG, **doc} merge, allowing legacy 'paytm' to override default. Fix (iter-117) mirrors the self-heal logic from _kiosk_qr_provider() into the GET endpoint: after reading the doc, if provider!='razorpay' it upserts back to razorpay, then returns razorpay unconditionally.
